ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated at the distal tips and scattered as surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base pigmentation across 85-90% of the visible surface; contiguous high-intensity circular clusters localized at the extreme distal tips; sparse, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks scattered across the lower and medial lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 55 degrees and a depth roughly 20% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the entire boundary; variations range from 5-15 pixels in amplitude, with the highest concentration of jagged peaks occurring on the distal-medial segment of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upwardly-oriented, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) isolated to the terminal edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible; most prominent are vertical marks on the lower left lobe and diagonal marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive terminal barnacle encrustation and multiple linear rake marks distributed across the ventral fluke surface.
